surface_mechanism_description: The Al dopants in SnO X may readily occupy interstitial sites below a critical doping level, above which substitutional occupation becomes favorable. The Al cations are anticipated to occupy interstitial sites to donate free electrons. As the Al concentration increases up to 1.5 at%, the microstructure appears to be preserved from the pure SnO X host, and the Al cations are interpreted to occupy interstitial sites in the SnO X matrix. Beyond this Al concentration, the Al cations begin to occupy substitutional sites in the SnO X matrix, and induce drastic changes in the crystal structure.
